📋 *Summary: Gemini discussion from #random*

• *Artem Bogdanov* kicked off the thread asking if anyone had tried the new *Gemini 3 Pro* model, noting it seems strong for frontend work.
• *Morgan Stanley* suggested sharing it with the UX team so they can play around with it.
• *John Doe* is more interested in the *Flash* version for the customer support bot, since latency is their current bottleneck — mentioned the previous nano version performed really well.
• *Omer Narwhal* asked if it's available in preview so it can be tested against current benchmarks.
• *Artem* confirmed it's in *developer preview* and said he'd share the docs link soon.

Overall takeaway: Team is interested in evaluating Gemini 3 Pro (frontend use cases) and Flash (latency-sensitive support bot), pending access to preview docs/benchmarks.
